name: Minerals plan
fact: 75 plans; 7 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-15; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: Plan discovery does not establish a current allocation, safeguarding polygon, extraction permission or exact parcel relation.

name: Minerals plan boundary
fact: 44 boundaries; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-11; new data 2026-03-18; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Boundary geometry routes responsibility only and is not a mineral allocation or site policy.

name: Waste plan
fact: 80 plans; 7 providers; collector and new-data date 2026-07-14; MHCLG-created pending authoritative replacement.
gate: A plan row is research routing, not a waste allocation, facility permission or parcel conclusion.

name: Waste plan boundary
fact: 48 boundaries; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-11; new data 2026-03-18; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Authority boundary does not identify a waste site, safeguarded facility or exact parcel impact.

name: Supplementary plan
fact: 5 plans; 2 providers; collector 2026-07-14; new data 2026-07-02; MHCLG-created origin with incomplete-coverage warning.
gate: Current adoption, document, applicable area and exact site relationship remain mandatory.

name: Plan event
fact: 47 event categories; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-14; new data 2026-02-25; includes adopted, withdrawn, consultation and examination milestones.
gate: Event vocabulary is not a plan-specific event date or proof of current plan status.

name: Plan timetable
fact: Dataset page reports 8,873 timetables from 71 providers; collector 2026-07-15 and new data 2026-07-14. Search surface reports 9,429 results.
gate: Count mismatch and MHCLG-created origin require plan-specific authoritative milestone verification before use.

name: Local area requirements
fact: 335 records; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2024-07-11; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: A checklist route does not prove which documents are required for a specific current application without authority readback.

name: Local planning group
fact: 47 groups; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2026-03-18; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Organisation responsibility does not create a plan policy, allocation or parcel result.

name: Planning application condition
fact: 5,305 records; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2025-06-21; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: A condition reference requires condition text, linked decision notice, discharge status and exact application/site relation.

name: Planning condition
fact: 5,605 records; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2025-06-21; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Condition data is not proof of compliance, discharge, implementation or exact canonical parcel effect.

name: Design code rule category
fact: 78 categories; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-21; new data 2025-07-10; categories include density, transport, water, biodiversity and accessibility.
gate: Category labels are not adopted design requirements or site capacity evidence.

name: Design code status
fact: 5 statuses; proposed, draft, adopted, withdrawn and informal; collector 2026-06-14; new data 2024-01-30.
gate: Status vocabulary requires a linked current design-code record and document before parcel use.

name: Design code rule
fact: 999 rules; 1 provider; collector 2026-02-24; new data 2024-06-11; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Rule rows require adopted-code linkage, current text, applicable area and exact parcel relation.

name: Development corporation
fact: 31 organisations; 2 providers; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2026-05-01; mixed origin.
gate: Organisation identity or powers do not grant permission, allocate land or prove parcel capacity.

name: National park authority
fact: 10 authorities including the Broads; 2 providers; collector 2026-07-22; new data 2026-01-31; mixed origin.
gate: Authority routing is not national-park geometry, policy applicability or parcel permission.

name: Passenger transport executive
fact: 9 organisations; 2 providers; collector 2026-06-03; new data 2025-02-28; mixed origin.
gate: Organisation existence does not establish service level, route access, frequency or parcel accessibility.

name: Regional park authority
fact: 1 authority; 2 providers; collector 2026-01-26; new data 2025-02-28; mixed origin.
gate: Authority identity is not park boundary, access right or parcel amenity evidence.

name: Building preservation notice
fact: 9 notices; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-19; new data 2026-07-17; Historic England attribution with MHCLG-created platform data.
gate: BPN protection is time-limited; current notice status, listing outcome, legal document and exact parcel/building relation are required.

name: Certificate of immunity
fact: 253 certificates; 1 provider; collector 2026-07-14; new data 2026-07-07; Historic England attribution and mixed origin.
gate: Certificate existence requires valid period, document and exact building/parcel relation; it is not development permission.

name: Planning application document
fact: 0 records; 0 providers; no collector attempt; MHCLG-created origin.
gate: Coverage gap cannot establish that an application has no plans, decision notice, reports or other documents.

name: Minerals plan design surface
fact: Research stage; expected records and frequency unknown; no specification or related dataset on the design surface; last updated 2025-11-14.
gate: Research-stage design metadata is not current plan or allocation evidence.

name: Planning conditions design surface
fact: Co-design stage; daily update expectation; technical specification and condition purpose/target/type datasets identified.
gate: Design model does not replace signed decision notices, condition text or discharge evidence.

name: Local area requirements design surface
fact: Test and iterate; expected 350 records; annual updates; no technical specification; last updated 2024-09-03.
gate: Design expectation and validation checklist routing do not determine a specific application's current requirements.
